record.name: Mechanic
record.description: You are a skilled mechanic, vehicle specialist, or repair technician who has mastered the art of fixing and maintaining various types of machinery and vehicles. Whether you work in a repair shop, serve as a ship's engineer, or operate as an independent contractor, your skills in technology, problem-solving, and understanding how things work make you invaluable. You understand the importance of proper maintenance and the satisfaction of getting things running again.

feature.name: Mechanic's Intuition
feature.description: Your experience with machinery has given you an almost supernatural ability to diagnose and fix problems. You have advantage on Technology checks when repairing or maintaining vehicles and machinery, and you can use your action to quickly assess the condition of a piece of equipment, potentially identifying problems before they become serious.

effects.notes: Advantage on Technology checks for repairs and maintenance
Quickly assess equipment condition and identify problems
